verdict.rationale: The DGX B200 docs confirm NVIDIA Container Toolkit/Docker support and reference standard NVIDIA tooling (nvidia-smi, Fabric Manager), and community evidence confirms real developers running CUDA workloads on B200 hardware, but the evidence pack never explicitly cites CUDA toolkit version support or an official 'supported target' listing in CUDA docs. Missing for 10: explicit CUDA compute-capability/toolkit release notes naming B200 as a supported GPU target, and no ROCm/HIP angle (not applicable to NVIDIA anyway) or independent benchmark validation of the toolchain itself.
